sheets.label: SHEET 1 OF 2
sheets.intro: Every design in the sticker collection, to print at home. Sticker paper from any stationers works, and so does ordinary paper with a glue stick. Cut along the dashed lines — or round the corners, which makes them last longer on a water bottle.
